# coolify_resource_tag (Resource)

Attaches a tag to an application, database or service — the attachment `coolify_tag` itself does not create. Coolify creates the team-wide tag on first attachment if it doesn't already exist. Tags drive batch deployment via `coolify_deployment`'s `tag` attribute (`/deploy?tag=...`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Attach the same tag to several resources, then deploy them all at once
# with `coolify_deployment`'s `tag` attribute.
resource "coolify_resource_tag" "web" {
  resource_type = "application"
  resource_uuid = coolify_application.web.uuid
  tag_name      = "production"
}

resource "coolify_resource_tag" "worker" {
  resource_type = "application"
  resource_uuid = coolify_application.worker.uuid
  tag_name      = "production"
}

resource "coolify_resource_tag" "db" {
  resource_type = "database"
  resource_uuid = coolify_database.pg.uuid
  tag_name      = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_type` (String) `application`, `database` or `service`. Changing it forces replacement.
- `resource_uuid` (String) UUID of the resource to tag. Changing it forces replacement.
- `tag_name` (String) Tag name (at least 2 characters after Coolify normalizes it — trimmed and lowercased). Changing it forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `tag_uuid` (String) UUID of the underlying team-wide tag.
